In a future city on the planet Orbis, a robot named Blinka lives. Orbis is a technologically advanced planet, without trees or any other type of plant life, so Blinka knows nothing about plants. This city is full of neon lights and holographic displays. Blinka is performing a mimicking behavior: it extends its arms, then brings them together above its head, regularly repeating this action, looking like the opening and closing of petals under the sun.

[Question]
What is Blinka possibly mimicking?

[Candidate Answers]
A. A blooming flower
B. The switch of flickering neon lights
C. A clam opening and closing its shell
D. The opening and closing of a book
